$comment: A draft-first PR flow. `--undo` flips a ready PR back to draft, which skips the heavy CI someone chose to run: refused. Ready starts the heavy CI, and a PR is marked ready only once the user has read it: it asks. The GraphQL road to the draft flip is the guard's code (evaluateGhApi).

deny.reason: Never flip a ready PR back to draft. Tell the user why you think it isn't ready.

ask.reason: Only the person merging marks a PR ready, and only after the user has read this PR and asked for it.
